propositions: match_predicate takes an unannotated `value` parameter whose type depends on the `op` argument (scalar for comparison ops, iterable for `in`, tuple for `range`), blocking tier-1 typing ratchet adoption for rebar.reducer
Annotating `value: object` produces 7 real mypy errors in the body; `value: Any` would suppress errors but provide no type safety or contract enforcement
PredicateValue operator-tagged union (str | AbstractSet[str] | tuple[str|None, str|None]) should be defined so operator and value shape travel together and body narrows by construction
match_predicate body should be refactored into per-field helpers along existing tag/priority/string-field seams to enable isinstance narrowing and reduce cognitive complexity
_parse_value return type should be tightened to tuple[str, PredicateValue]; search_states pass-through verified to preserve no-signature-change invariant
rebar.reducer.* must be promoted into tier-1 mypy override and _RATCHET_BASELINE after mypy src/rebar/reducer --disallow-untyped-defs passes clean with no new Any annotations
